SELECT id, x FROM (VALUES (1, 'A', 1, 4, 0), (2, 'A', 1, 2, 0), (3, 'B', 1, 7, 0)) t(id, product, period, v, w) DECIDE x(INT), per t.product: y(INT), per t.w: z(INT)
        SUCH THAT x <= 9 AND z <= 9 AND per t.product: y <= at(previous else z: x) over (t.period within t.product) MAXIMIZE sum(x)
